dataAcquisitionBlocker.summary: Verified launch pack contains 0 records because repository evidence was insufficient for trustworthy launch.
dataAcquisitionBlocker.detail: Mission 25 inventoried every candidate education record already present in this repository. No record met the bar of REAL + SOURCE-BACKED. Every candidate is a demo/placeholder, a synthetic generator output, or a test fixture. Attaching an official-looking URL to those records would be exactly the fabrication this pipeline exists to prevent, so the pack is empty by design.
dataAcquisitionBlocker.resolutionRequires: A separately approved research/data acquisition operation that retrieves and records first-party evidence (official test-provider, government, institution and scholarship-provider pages) with retrieval and verification timestamps. Mission 25 performs no network access, no scraping and no live source verification.
